app.name: Pure3D
app.description: Create and edit 3D models, materials and keyframe animations.

createEntities.label: 3D scene
createEntities.description: Create a starter 3D scene with editable primitive shapes.

tools.name: fn_inspectSceneHealth
tools.description: Inspect the active 3D scene in one read-only call: returns header, counts by kind, lighting/look summary, hierarchy stats, texture asset usage, actionable visual/structural warnings (grid left on, unlit night scenes, plain toy-like surfaces, broken scatter terrain refs, orphaned textures, out-of-range keys), plus optional on-demand generator/kit/material/surface catalogs so you never guess parameter names.

includeCatalog.description: Optional catalog reference to return: generator param schemas, CC0 kit model names/sizes, material presets, procedural surfaces, or all.

focusIds.description: Optional object IDs to inspect in detail with transforms, params, and resolved inherited materials.

nameContains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter detailed object inspection.

limit.description: Maximum number of outline or focused object rows to return (default 40).

tools.name: fn_composeScene
tools.description: Compose or update a 3D scene atomically in one call: optionally start a clean empty scene with a title, add primitives, procedural generators (terrain, scatter, building, tree, rock, water, boat, dock, fence, lantern, light, backdrop, crate, barrel, bench, roundedBox) or bundled CC0 kit models (kind "model") using ergonomic shorthand transforms/materials, update or delete existing objects, patch scene settings/look, optionally frame a hero camera shot, and autosave.

resetScene.description: When true, starts from a clean empty scene before applying additions and settings.

add.description: Objects to add: { kind, id?, name?, parentId?, visible?, position?, rotation?, scale?, material?, params? }. Kinds: box, sphere, cylinder, cone, torus, plane, group, terrain, scatter, tree, rock, water, roundedBox, building, boat, dock, fence, lantern, crate, barrel, bench, model, light, backdrop.

updates.description: Objects to update: { id, name?, parentId?, visible?, position?, rotation?, scale?, material?, params?, clearMaterialOverride? }.

removeIds.description: Object IDs to delete (each removes its subtree and animation keys).

settings.description: Optional scene settings patch: { duration?, fps?, background?, grid?, look? }.

selectId.description: Optional object ID to select after editing.

shot.description: Camera framing: explicit { position: [x,y,z], target: [x,y,z], fov? } or subject-framed { objectIds?, azimuth?, elevation?, fill?, distance?, fov? }.

tools.name: fn_setupLightingAndLook
tools.description: Configure scene lighting, atmosphere, studio backdrop, practical lights, and post-processing grade in one atomic save. Choose a curated preset (golden-hour, studio-product, moonlit-night, overcast-day, dramatic-dusk, clean-daylight) and/or supply custom settings.look overrides, optional studio cyclorama + 3-point area-light rig aimed at a subject, explicit point/spot/area lights, grid toggle, and optional hero camera framing.

preset.description: Curated atmosphere & lighting preset. Custom look fields override preset values.

look.description: Optional settings.look fields merged over any preset (environment, sunElevation, sunAzimuth, sunIntensity, sunColor, haze, clouds, shadows, fog, exposure, ambientOcclusion, bloom, focusDistance, aperture, lightShafts, saturation, contrast, warmth, vignette, stars).

grid.description: Show or hide the viewport grid (presets default grid to false for clean renders).

addStudioRig.description: When true, adds or updates a seamless studio cyclorama backdrop plus 3-point key/fill/rim area lights aimed at studioTarget.

studioTarget.description: World [x, y, z] center that the 3-point studio rig aims at (default [0, 0.7, 0]).

studioBackdropColor.description: Optional #rrggbb color for the studio cyclorama backdrop (default #e9e7e3).

lights.description: Explicit lights to add or update by id: { type: "point"|"spot"|"area", position: [x,y,z], id?, name?, target?: [x,y,z], color?, intensity?, range?, angle?, softness?, width?, height?, shadows?: "yes"|"no" }.

shot.description: Camera framing: explicit { position: [x,y,z], target: [x,y,z], fov? } or subject-framed { objectIds?, azimuth?, elevation?, fill?, distance?, fov? }.

tools.name: fn_styleMaterialsAndTextures
tools.description: Apply PBR material presets (gold, glass, marble, varnished-wood, velvet, etc.), procedural surfaces (wood, stone, brick, fabric, etc.), emissive/clearcoat/roughness overrides, retained texture assets, UV tiling patches, and/or one AI-generated texture across explicit object IDs, object kinds, or name matches in a single saved workflow.

assignments.description: Material/surface/texture assignments: { objectIds?, kinds?, nameContains?, recursive?, clearOverride?, material?: { preset?, color?, metalness?, roughness?, opacity?, wireframe?, emissive?, emissiveIntensity?, clearcoat?, transmission?, sheen?, surface?, surfaceScale?, surfaceStrength? }, textureAssetId?, texturePatch?: { color?, repeat?, offset?, rotation?, flipY?, wrapS?, wrapT? } }.

generateTexture.description: Optional single AI texture generation request: { objectId, prompt, size?: "auto"|"1024x1024"|"1536x1024"|"1024x1536", editExisting?, applyToObjectIds?, recursive?, texturePatch? }.

tools.name: fn_directCameraAndShots
tools.description: Direct the scene camera and animated camera track in one call: frame and save a heroShot, author a smooth multi-keyframe camera orbit or custom shot sequence (auto-extending scene duration when needed), detect blockedBy occluders on every camera angle, toggle cameraPreview playback, optionally render up to 4 verification viewport PNGs without moving the saved camera, and autosave.

heroShot.description: Camera framing: explicit { position: [x,y,z], target: [x,y,z], fov? } or subject-framed { objectIds?, azimuth?, elevation?, fill?, distance?, fov? }.

clearExistingKeys.description: When true, removes all existing scene.cameraKeys before adding new orbit or shot keyframes.

duration.description: Optional scene duration in seconds (automatically extended if any authored keyframe exceeds current duration).

orbit.description: Generate an evenly spaced multi-keyframe camera orbit: { objectIds?, startAzimuth?, endAzimuth?, elevation?, distance?, fill?, fov?, startTime?, endTime?, steps? (2-24), easing?: "linear"|"smooth"|"step" }.

shots.description: Explicit camera keyframes: { time, easing?: "linear"|"smooth"|"step", shot }.

cameraPreview.description: Enable or disable animated camera track preview.

time.description: Move the playhead to this time in seconds.

capturePreview.description: When true and the viewport renderer is available, renders up to 4 preview PNG stills of the hero/keyframed shots without disturbing the saved camera.

size.description: Long-edge pixel dimension for preview renders (256-2048).

tools.name: getScene
tools.description: Read the active scene, file path, selection and playback. This is the only tool that returns scene detail: change tools reply with a short summary (ids, counts, path), so read here only what the next step needs. With no arguments it returns the complete scene. Narrow it with ids (includeDescendants:true adds each subtree), kinds, name (case-insensitive substring) and within (axis-aligned box tested against each object's world-space origin from its saved transforms, ignoring animation); filters combine with AND, keyframes are limited to the returned objects, and match reports counts and unknown ids. geometry:false replaces mesh arrays with vertex/triangle counts. summary:true returns counts by kind, settings, texture asset ids and an outline of id/name/kind/parentId per object instead of full objects (default limit 200; limit caps the returned objects in either mode and objectsMore reports the rest). Prefer summary:true or filters on large scenes. Embedded texture dataUrl bytes are always omitted. Rotations are XYZ Euler radians, time is seconds, positions use meters. Objects are box/sphere/cylinder/cone/torus/plane/group/mesh (primitives have unit size) or generated shapes (terrain/scatter/tree/rock/water/roundedBox) that carry params instead of triangles. settings.look holds the scene's light and finish.

tools.name: setWorkspace
tools.description: Operate selection, transform mode, playback, playhead, looping, inspector visibility, cameraPreview or frame selection. cameraPreview:true uses the animated camera track at the playhead, with clean 16:9 framing; false restores the editing camera. Combine cameraPreview:true, time:0, playing:true to play a camera journey. Preview does not rewrite the saved shots or object animation. selectedVertex selects a mesh vertex and pauses playback; null returns to object mode. Changing objects, rotating/scaling or playing exits vertex mode. Framing saves the editing camera; selection, preview and scrubbing are transient. Replies with the resulting workspace state and the selected object id/name/kind; framing also returns the saved path and camera. shot sets and saves the editing camera: {position, target, fov?} exactly, or framed on objectIds (default: everything) from azimuth (degrees round it, 0 = from +z, 90 = from +x; default 35) and elevation (degrees above; default 18) with the subject filling fill of the frame (default 0.85; 0.4 for a wide shot with room around it, 1.2 for a tight crop) or at an exact distance, fov 10-120 (35-50 natural, 20-30 telephoto for products and portraits, 70+ wide). Add shotAt (seconds) to upsert that shot as a camera keyframe instead. The reply has the resulting camera, and blockedBy lists objects standing between the camera and the subject (move closer, change the angle, or raise a scatter's avoid radius).

tools.name: captureViewport
tools.description: Read a finished render of the active scene as a PNG at the current playhead: the scene's look (sky, sun shadows, fog, contact shadows, glow, focus), rendered off screen at twice the size and scaled down, without gizmos or the selection box. Uses the on-screen size or, while Pure3D is hidden, its last known size (1280x720 if never shown), so it works while hidden. Refuses if the renderer is unavailable, and returns an error with no image rather than a blank one when the render comes back empty; then use getScene. Returns the image with a one-line note (title, playhead time); use getScene for scene data. Optional aspect (16:9, 3:2, 4:3, 1:1, 4:5, 2:3, 9:16, 21:9) and size (long edge in pixels, 256-2048) set the picture's shape and size. views (up to 4 shots, each as setWorkspace shot: {position, target, fov?} or {objectIds?, azimuth, elevation, fill?/distance?, fov?}) renders one image per view, for checking a subject from several sides in one call; the note gives each view's camera (with blockedBy when something stands in front of the subject) so a good one can be kept with setWorkspace shot. Views and capture options never change the saved camera.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Undo or redo one edit in the active scene. Returns what that step changed (object ids, counts), canUndo/canRedo, undoSteps/redoSteps, and one-line descriptions of the next five undo and redo entries, nearest first.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover Pure3D's extended specialist tools (10 tools across assets, documents, editing, textures) and composite functions (5 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "assets", "documents", "editing", "textures").

category.description: Optional category filter (assets, documents, editing, textures, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of Pure3D's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: assets, documents, editing, textures). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of Pure3D's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: assets, documents, editing, textures). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
